text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув seems unwell, so I take her
to the
infirmary.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Please... You're worrying over nothing.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
But I won't argue. It's hard to when you
look that
worried...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
You can head home. If it's a break you
want me to
take, I'll listen.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Hmm? Where am I? Last I remember, I
was in the
infirmary...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Who goes there?!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Isn't it obvious? I'm you.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув (?)

text_block_list.text:
You haven't changed a bit—incapable of

following even the simplest instructions.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув (?)

text_block_list.text:
Surely you realize the accuracy of your
trainer's
remarks.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув (?)

text_block_list.text:
Be that as it may, I'll never grow if I'm
always
clinging to my trainer's knee like
a child.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Clinging to someone and trusting
someone are
two different things. If you
trust them, then you
must allow yourself
to rely on them.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув (?)

text_block_list.text: You... have a point. However—
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Enough with this "however" nonsense!
You'll never
grow if you let this foolish
pride of yours
constantly cloud your
judgment!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув (?)

text_block_list.text:
Perhaps you're right. I must learn how to
be more
trusting.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: What... in the world just happened?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Hm? My body feels awfully light...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I don't know what that was, but it was
certainly
insightful. I should go and say
thanks later.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: What in the world was that?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
What a strange dream... I never imagined
I'd get
to experience one of my own
lectures.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Thanks to her rest, Эйр Грув is back in
form.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Being on the receiving end sure takes a lot out of you though... Sigh...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
